title: A game master enters WC_Duel_Arena and its EnterZone triggers run their ResSpawn spawners
notes: 9.04: gm-zone-transfer.json with WC_Duel_Arena as the target. Trigger 2 'Start Dueling' fires on EnterZone
and runs ResSpawn on spawners that start inactive (Spawn point GoodGuy/BadGuy); the game server logs what the triggers spawned.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
steps.pattern: Security level of \S+ set to 2

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen
log in
the server accepts the password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server puts the wizard in the Commons
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the main wizard backs away from the start
the main wizard alone
the client brings its renderer up (companion)
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen (companion)
log in (companion)
the server accepts the password (companion)
steps.pattern: authenticated as {companion_user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted (companion)
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads (companion)
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen (companion)
press play (companion)

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key (companion)
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server puts the wizard in the Commons (companion)
steps.pattern: put wizard {companion_wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the two wizards are shown to each other
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {companion_wizard_guid} and the (\d+) wizard\(s\) already in instance \d+ were shown to each other

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it (companion)
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {companion_wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: open the chat line to type .tele zone to a zone that does not exist
take out the slash the key writes before .tele zone to a zone that does not exist
type .tele zone to a zone that does not exist
send .tele zone to a zone that does not exist
a zone that does not exist is refused
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran tele zone Nowhere/NoSuchZone, which (\S+)

steps.name: the game master is told and stays in the Commons
open the chat line to type .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena
take out the slash the key writes before .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena
type .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena
send .tele zone WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena
the client is asked to leave the Commons
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked its client to leave WizardCity/WC_Hub for WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena

steps.name: the companion sees the game master leave
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was taken away from the (\d+) wizard\(s\) still in instance

steps.name: the client acknowledges and is sent with a transfer key
steps.pattern: sent wizard {wizard_guid} from WizardCity/WC_Hub to WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena at (\S+) with a single-use transfer key

steps.name: the loading screen
the companion sees the game master gone
the client attaches again with the transfer key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the arena's EnterZone triggers run their spawn results
steps.pattern: Triggers .* in instance \d+ of WizardCity/WC_Duel_Arena spawned (\d+) and took away \d+ object

steps.name: the game master arrives at the arena's Start
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in (\S+) instance \d+ at

steps.name: the client loads the Duel Arena
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the game master in the Duel Arena
the game master in the arena after the triggers ran
